messages:
maya: Quick sync — product needs sequencing and owners for the 'tenant-rate-limit embeddings' ask from VegaCorp. Customer target: GA ~6 weeks. Can we map runtime/infra/security dependencies and a minimal launch checklist?

raj: Thanks — a few clarifying q's: is this per-tenant model selection + rate-limits on embedding calls, or a gateway-level rate limit?

maya: Gateway-level quota + per-tenant soft throttling + an optional dedicated embedding cache per tenant for hot keys. Product acceptance: 95th latency <= 150ms, throughput 300 req/s for tier-1 tenants, and feature flag toggles per-tenant.

lucas: From eng side I think we need: batching window adjustments, per-tenant KV namespace isolation, and a cache-eviction policy. Runtime impact: changes to continuous batching + sharding of KV cache.

raj: Runtime: agree. Work items I see — (1) KV namespace abstraction (2) cache isolation toggles (3) batch-sizing heuristic that respects tenant rate limit. Estimate: 3 weeks for core changes, +1 week for testing.

jin: Infra notes: we need extra Redis clusters (or separate DBs) for isolation, NLB rules for tenant routing, and reserved capacity for peak throughput. Also want to pre-allocate 2x p99 capacity for initial canary. Lead time for provisioning infra in prod: ~10 business days unless we reuse staging infra.

sophia: Security requirements: KMS-backed tenant keys for cache encryption, audit events for every embedding request (tenant id, model id, latency), and privacy review for cached embeddings. Also a short pen test window if we touch VPC peering. Timeline: audit + key integration ~2 weeks.

ellie: QA/PD: we need an embedding-quality regression harness (cosine similarity baseline on control set) and synthetic load tests for steady-state + burst. Also need per-tenant rollout gating: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with quality & latency gates.

maya: Great. Can we turn that into a sequencing plan and a minimal launch checklist? Suggest minimal GA scope: per-tenant rate limit config, feature flag, monitoring dashboard, and rollback. Anything else?

raj: Minimal runtime deliverables: KV namespace + cache isolation toggle, batch heuristic respecting tenant quota, and an API flag to enable per-tenant caching. No quantization changes for GA.

jin: Minimal infra deliverables: provision 1 Redis cluster for canary tenants (isolation), route rule, capacity reservation ticket, and infra-as-code PR. We can reuse an existing Redis cluster for early canary to shorten lead time.

sophia: Minimal security deliverables: KMS integration for caching encryption, audit logging to our existing pipeline, and privacy signoff on cache TTL/purge policy. Pen test can be scoped post-canary but must be scheduled before 100% rollout.

ellie: Minimal QA deliverables: regression harness, load test script, and a canary observability dashboard with: latency p50/p95/p99, error rate, and embedding-similarity metric.

maya: OK owners & rough ETA (aiming GA in 6 weeks):
- Product: maya — ship plan, acceptance criteria, customers communication (this week)
- Runtime: raj — KV and batching changes (3w)
- Infra: jin — canary Redis + routing (10bd)
- Security: sophia — KMS + audit (2w)
- QA: ellie — harness & canary metrics (2w)
- Eng: lucas — integration + feature flag + rollout automation (3w)

raj: I'll break runtime work into three tickets and mark one as blocker: KV abstraction (must land first).

jin: I'll open infra ticket today for Redis provisioning and link capacity request to the runtime blocker.

sophia: I need the cache TTL proposal and tenant data flow diagram to complete the privacy review. Maya can you supply?

maya: On it — I'll post the data flow + TTL proposal by EOD.

ellie: Can we schedule a 30m sync Wednesday to go over gating metrics?

maya: Yes — 11am Wed works for me.

deploy-bot: prod-deploy-checklist: no deploys blocking this thread.

lucas: One more risk: if KV abstraction changes cause cold-starts we might see 2-3x latency spikes during rollout. Proposed mitigation: staged canary with traffic mirror + gradual cache warm-up.

raj: Agreed — add warm-up job to runtime tickets.

maya: Action items recap (short):
1) maya: post TTL + dataflow today
2) raj: create runtime tickets (KV abstraction blocker) by EOD
3) jin: infra ticket + capacity request today
4) sophia: privacy checklist once dataflow posted
5) ellie: load scripts + dashboard prototype by next Tue
6) lucas: feature flag + rollout automation PR in 3w
7) schedule 11am Wed sync

maya: If no objections I'll convert this thread into a short JIRA epic and add owners. Otherwise speak now. :thumbsup:

ellie: +1

raj: +1

jin: +1

sophia: +1

lucas: +1

maya: Thanks everyone — I'll create the epic and share links in this thread after the sync.
